content: Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-mormar-soblegoed
Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga sogdebalid: “Be-ia-Aarón, degi, e-machimala Nadab, Abiú, Eleazar, Itamar, amala bese warmaked be imako. Wemar, anga Israel-dulemar-abargi dule-irwa-anse-gormaladga gumaloed.
Be-ia-Aarónʼgala dule-irwa-anse-goled-bur-dummad-mormar be imako, adi, oyogega, be-ia-Aarónʼde dule-dummadye, nue-nug-nikadye.
Bela dulemar-mormaked-wisimaladbo be sunmako. We-dulemar Aarónʼga mor-makmalaga an ega gurgin-nuegan uksad. Deyobi, Aarón dule-irwa-anse-goledga an nug-imakegar.
”Aarónʼga mormar-maklegoedi, wemalad:
”Degisoggu, be-ia-Aarónʼga, degi, e-masmalaga, dule-irwa-anse-goled-mormar be imakoed, adi, amala dule-irwa-anse-gormaladga gumalagar.
”We-mormar-makegala, we-dubmar ebulegoed:
Mor-efodʼye-nugad-maklegoed
Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga sogdebalid:
”E-mor-gukinmar ebo atogegala, morgo warakwaa be imakoed, e-duku-e-dukugi ebo gwadiegar.
Mor-efodʼye-nugad-e-mordub-sadergi-naid, nue-yeerdakle be imakoed. We-mordub mor-efodʼgi gwadiar-nai guoed. We-mordub-makega, be we-dubmar ebugoed:
”Degine, akwa-óniceʼye-nugad gwabo be suoed. A-akwa-gwabogwadgi Israel-masmala-warambe-gakabogwad-e-nugmar (12) be narmakoed.

Gwagwengi masmala-walanergwad-e-nugmar (6) be narmakoed, degine, akwa-baidgine, baigan walanergwad-e-nugmar (6) be narmakbaloed. Be-narmakoedi, machi-dummadgi be onodagoed, geb machi-bipigwadse, e-gwalulesmaladba be narmakoed.
Dule-orgi-arbaedi we-nugmar we-akwamar-birgi narmakoed, igi wilub-nasikega imakdamala, deyob imakoed. We-akwamar-dikargi or be nasikoed, adi, akwamar agi galegegar.
We-akwamar-gwabogwad mor-efodʼye-nugad-gukinmargi be nasikoed. Weyob, Aarón, Israel-dadgan-warambe-gakabogwad-e-nug (12) an-asabin nai gudioed, adi, ani Bab-Jehová, an we-dulemar insaegar.
Akwamar-gwabogwad-gaegala, or be imakoed. A-birgi akwamar be sioed.
Degine, e-dub-orbiid giabo be imakoed, akwa-gwabogwad-sigoed agi be edinnoed.”
Mor-binasgargi-nagued-maklegoed
Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga sogdebalid: “Geb degine, mor-binasgargi-nagued, igar-nabolegedgi-ebulegega, nue-yeerdakle be imakoed. Mor-efodʼye-nugad-imaksadyob be imakbaloed. ”We-dubmar be ebugoed:

content.text: E-sugued, degi, e-matardungued emarbi be imakoed,

content: ”Akwa-nuegana gwaambe-gakabo (12) guoed, Israel-masmala-warambe-gakabogwad-iliba (12). Igi wilub-nasikega imakdamala, deyob, akwa-gwa-gwagwengi, Israel-dulemar-dadgan-sogambe-gakabogwad-e-nugmar iliba be nasikoed.
”Mor-binasgargi-naguedga ordub-nued sinni-sinni be soboed.
Geb degine, be olua-gwabo-olobiid mor-binasgargi-nagued-e-dukumargi be nasikoed.
Geb ordubmar-sinni-sinnid-giabogwad mor-binasgargi-nagued-e-dukugi olua-gwabogwad-naidgi be nasikoed.
Mor-efodʼye-nugad-nasikegala, ordubmar-sinni-sinnid-giabogwad be akwa-nuegan-e-gukingi-siidgi-edinnar nasikoed.
”Deginbali, be olua-gwabo-olobiid be imakbaloed. We-ormar mor-binasgargi-naguedyaba, e-dukumargi be nasikoed. Be nasikoedi, mor-efodʼgi naguegalad.
Deginbali, napi be olua-gwabo-olobiid be imakbaloed. We-ormar mor-efodʼye-nugad-e-dikarnagaba be nasikoed. E-abingunaidgi yaba-dogar be nasikoed.

Geb degine, mor-binasgargi-nagued-e-olua-gwabogwad, mor-efodʼye-nugad-e-olua-gwabo-naimogad-ebo dub-aradgi edillegoed. Adi, mor-efodʼye-nugad dub-saderba-naidgi naguegar. Deyob guoed, adi, mor-binasgargi-nagued melle mor-efodʼgi bachikii guegar.
”Weyobi, Aarón, anse-goled-neg-islidikidyaba dogdele, igar-nabogega mor-binasgargi-nagued-ebulegedgi Israel-e-masmala-e-nug naigu guoed. Adi, an wemar-e-binsadigu guegar.

”Deginbali, mor-binasgargi-nagued, igar-nabogega-ebulegedgi, be Urim, degi, Tumim sioed. Adi, Aarón an-asabin-dogder, e-binasgargi-nai dogegar. Weyobi, Aarón, an-asabin-gwisgudaged-ilibali, e-binasgargi Israel-dulemarga igar-nabogega sedigu guegar.”
Dule-irwa-Babse-goled e-mormar-baigan-imaklegoed
Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga sogdebalid: “Mor-dummad-efodʼye-nugad, bela mor-aradbi be imakoed.
Nono-odogega, abargine mor-gammu be sikoed. Mor-gammu-e-dikar bela-ebilis be ebayoed, adi, melle achirmakegar.
”Mor-dummad-e-nag-dukugi bela-ebirar yeerdakle be soboed.

content.text: Deyob, muchub-muchub bela-ebilis mor-dummad-e-nag-dukugi be nasikoed.

content: ”Aarón, dule-irwa anse-gorsokalile, we-mola-yoi dogoed. Adi, e-gapan-burwigana-goled mag itolegegar. Aarón an-asabin Neg-Islidikidse-dogder, degine, agi noarbalir, gapan-burwigana-goled mag itolebaloed. Deyob imakele, Aarón burgosulid.
”Deginbali, or-nued matarkwaa be imakbalo. Geb a-birgine, wilub-nasikega-imakdamaladyob be we-gayaburba nasikoed: ‘BAB-JEHOVÁʼGA SWILIDIK-NUGSALEGALED.’
”We-olo-matargwagwad dub-aradgi-edinnar mor-gurgin-ebirmakaled-asabinnidgi be nasikoed.
Weyobi, Aarón-bebegi nai guoed. We-olo-matargwagwad sogleged:

”Degine, mor-dummad-dubgi-ise-nue-sobaled lino-morye-nugadgi be imakoed, degine, mor-gurgin-ebirmakaled amba lino-morgi be imakbaloed. Deginbali, morgo-dub-sadergi-nagued ise-nue-sobar, bela-bela nue-yeerdakle be imakbaloed.
Deginbali, Aarón-e-masmalaga mor-dummad-dubgi-ise-nue-sobaled, degi, morgo-dub-sadergi-nagued, degine, mor-gurgin ega be imakmogo. Adi, oyolegegar, wemarde dule-dummaganye, nue-nug-nikamaladye.
”We-mormar be imaksadi, be-ia-Aarónʼga, degine, e-masmalaga be yooed. Geb degine, gwallu-wawa amar-nonogi be eogoed. Geb degi, dule-irwa-anse-gormaladga-gumalaga be onugsaoed.
Deginbali, lino-mor garson-bipi-urba-yolegedga be imakoed, adi, wemar melle uka-swiri gumalagar. We-garson-bipi saderse, geb duase-sugu yooed.

Aarón, degi, e-masmala, dulemar-anbo-ambikued-negse-dogdemalale, we-garson-bipi-yoi dogmaloed. Degine, anga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-ailase nadmalale, amba we-garson-bipi-yoi dogbaloed. Adi, wemala melle isgumalagar. Ar isgumalale, wemala burgwemaloed. Aarónʼgala, degi, e-masmalagala, we-igar degisadegu-mai guoed.”
